title: 13.14. Hīnattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Hīnaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahīno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikatikasadisaṁ.)
Hetuyā ekūnavīsa, ārammaṇe nava …pe… vipāke ekādasa …pe… avigate ekūnavīsa.
